node.statement: Apply GT-kitaev-canonical-stinespring to Delta to obtain a finite-dimensional Stinespring space G, an isometry W:H->G, and a unital *-representation pi:B->B(G) with Delta(X)=W^*pi(X)W. For each block central unit e_j put G_j=pi(e_j)G, choose matrix units e_rs^(j) in B(L_j), put E_j=pi(e_11^(j))G_j (possibly zero), and define Q_j:L_j tensor E_j->G_j by Q_j(e_r tensor z)=pi(e_r1^(j))z. The matrix-unit identities show that Q_j is unitary and Q_j^*pi(X)Q_j=X_j tensor I_Ej on G_j. Thus W_j:=Q_j^*pi(e_j)W satisfies sum_j W_j^*W_j=I_H and Delta(X)=sum_j W_j^*(X_j tensor I_Ej)W_j.
